official who executes a judgment for debt, esp. public debt, bailiff, , al., , Decr. ap. , , (Imbros, ii B.C.), (Pergam.), ; βασιλικὸς π. (iii B.C.); τῶν ξενικῶν (ii B.C.).
collector of taxes, π. βαλανήου Ostr. in Wilcken Grundzüge (i A.D.), (i A.D.); π. ἀργυρικῶν (ii A.D.), (ii A.D.), etc.; π. σιτικῶν, al. (ii A.D.).
